## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Moderate (Top 5 span 3 sectors); market showing money shift across Tech, Utilities and Consumer Discretionary rather than a pure defensive bid.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +0.60%), VST RECOVERY (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%). Consumer Discretionary strong: F ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%), ROST ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%). Healthcare showing breadth: MRK ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials lagging with weakness: DOW BELOW TREND (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%). Industrials mixed-to-weak with DE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) and BA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -6.46%). Communication/Media shows select pressure: TTWO CORRECTION (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +8.41%) and INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%), IBM ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%), VST RECOVERY (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%), F ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%), ROST ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%). Leadership: Moderate (Top 5 across 3 sectors).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%), WMT BELOW TREND (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%), DOW BELOW TREND (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%), DE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%), NEE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.15% | 1M: -8.00%). Weakness concentrated in Materials/Industrials and select staples.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +18.20%), IBM (1W: +15.75%), VST (1W: +11.88%), F (1W: +11.42%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%). Note MAJOR divergence among mega-caps (NVDA CORRECTION, GOOGL CORRECTION, MSFT CORRECTION) — tactical risk, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +13.05%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +79.45%) coexist with NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) and GOOGL CORRECTION (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%). Technology included among the 10/11 positive sectors but internals show rotation and profit-taking.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials steady-to-constructive: JPM RECOVERY (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -1.70%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +6.70%), MA RECOVERY (1W: +0.88% | 1M: -0.76%). Financials are participating in the rotation and provide cyclical exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthy breadth: LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%), MRK ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +1.60%), UNH CORRECTION (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +9.56%). Sector shows defensive and growth pockets simultaneously.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selectively rotated exposure into Financials, Healthcare and high-momentum Tech winners while reducing exposure to names showing BELOW TREND in Materials/Industrials. Monitor large-cap divergences — treat gains in narrow leadership as tactical, not broad market confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%). BEARISH: INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%), WMT BELOW TREND (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%), DE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities, Consumer Discretionary, Healthcare (part of Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive). BEARISH: Materials and select Industrials where weakness is concentrated.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) for failure to hold short-term support as a trigger for wider tech weakness; monitor AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +13.05%) for continuation above monthly trend; JPM RECOVERY (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -1.70%) weekly close above recent highs would signal continued rotation into banks.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
IBM (+70): IBM ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) — Quantum chip news confirming price action. AMD (+65): AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) — AI infra investment confirms momentum. MRK (+80): MRK ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) — trial news confirming accumulation. LLY (+80): LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) — clinical beat confirming price strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MSFT (-50): MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +0.90%) — negative headlines and small pullback align, watch for further traction. HD (-50): HD RECOVERY (1W: +5.23% | 1M: -7.96%) — sell-side pressure vs short-term bounce is a divergence to monitor. META (-45): META BELOW TREND (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -7.42%) — legal/media pressure confirming weaker trend.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%), IBM ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) showing strength. Key risk: major divergence among mega-caps (NVDA CORRECTION, GOOGL CORRECTION, MSFT CORRECTION) and several bearish headlines (BLK, BAC) warrant monitoring.
